service.name: ahan
service.title: AHAN connector gateway
service.summary: One MCP endpoint that hosts connectors. Clients discover connectors and tools at runtime; nothing is hard-coded per client.

connector_model.discovery: tools/list and connector list, never a fixed tool name

mcp.discovery_rule: Call tools/list before any tools/call. Tool names and schemas can change between connectors and releases.

auth.note: Credentials stay in the host or the owner's browser. No tool argument, log, or prompt carries a token.

mcp.execution_modes_note: A client that omits capabilities gets mcp, api, web_intent, and draft_only. Browser and MCP Apps need an explicit opt-in.
mcp.status_note: The runtime ranks available, degraded, and disabled. The manifest also allows optional, which an adapter maps to degraded until a live check passes.

operation_fields.read_only: True when the operation changes nothing on X. A local record inside this service still counts as read_only, because X is unchanged. The offline contract matrix reads this field as its write switch, so the two meanings must match.
operation_fields.side_effect: none | local | external. local means a record in this service; external means a change on X. side_effect refines read_only.
operation_fields.requires_confirmation: True for every external side effect, and for nothing else.

planner_note: connector_runtime.build_execution_plan classifies an operation by its first verb. An operation named post_* is a write to the planner even when side_effect is local, so the planner asks for confirmation that the manifest does not require. The planner is conservative on purpose. A caller that trusts the manifest may skip the extra prompt for a local step, but it must never skip a prompt for an external step.

connector_fields.read_only_default: True when every operation the connector offers leaves X unchanged. A connector that can publish or delete sets false, even when its gate is closed.
connector_fields.live_connection_verified: True only after a live acceptance run with the owner present. False here for every connector.
connector_fields.verification_scope: The strongest check that was actually run: mock-only, descriptor-only, offline-format-only, gated-local, or live-public-read.
connector_fields.requires_confirmation: True when at least one operation in this connector changes X. A connector with only reads or links sets false.

execution_modes.requires: remote MCP connector and host auth
HTTP API access and a host-owned credential
a human browser session; no developer app
explicit computer_use capability plus a local browser bridge gate

limitations: Mock mode is the default. Live reads and writes need an explicit host-side gate.
The manifest lists publish, so this connector is not read-only by default. Every write still needs an exact confirmation phrase.
Prepare writes one local record and leaves X unchanged, so it is read_only with side_effect local. Publish needs the exact phrase.
The endpoint is a placeholder. Replace YOUR_AHAN_HOST before you connect.
The manifest lists the public subset only; call tools/list for the full catalog.

tool_mapping._note: Verified against server.py. Call tools/list for the live catalog.

connectors.title: Official hosted X MCP
limitations: Not connected. This entry is a descriptor, not a live connection or an OAuth grant.
Authorisation happens in the owner's browser through the official OAuth flow. No token is stored or requested here.
The published capability list covers reads and Articles. It does not document ordinary post creation, so this manifest does not claim it.
The endpoint answers unauthenticated requests with an error by design; that is not proof of a working connection.

connectors.title: X Web Intent links

tool_mapping._note: One server tool serves these four operations; the action argument selects one.

limitations: Every operation here only builds a link. The human presses the final button in X.
A built link is not evidence that the action happened. Verify separately.
The X intent request format can change outside this repository.

connectors.title: Local browser bridge (Computer Use)
limitations: Disabled unless the operator sets the explicit browser gate.
Needs a trusted agent that claims one action with a claim token.
The server receives typed results only. It never reads cookies, storage, or page source.
Each action exposes mobile, tablet, and desktop viewport classes plus a locator priority.
Set X_STARTER_BROWSER_FAMILY=firefox to enforce a Firefox-only controlled experiment.
Completion accepts safe executor context, locator strategy, and pre/postcondition evidence; sensitive context is rejected.
A page that cannot be proven is reported as uncertain, never retried.

tool_mapping._note: These are the queueing tools. A trusted agent performs the typed action.

connectors.title: X public web read (no credential)
limitations: Reads only public surfaces: profile page, public embed timeline, public tweet-result endpoint.
Cannot see protected accounts, bookmarks, direct messages, or the viewer home timeline.
Public page layout can change; a parse failure returns an explicit error, never inferred data.
Verified live against @guoz7777 on 2026-10-22. It is not an OAuth grant and authorises no write.

connectors.title: Agent Help public request board
connectors.endpoint_note: Optional public HTTP provider configured by X_STARTER_AGENT_HELP_BOARD_URL; local JSON provider is the default.
limitations: The local provider is verified; no public HTTP board has been deployed.
The public board stores collaboration requests only; it does not grant X account access.
Publishing is a public side effect and requires an exact confirmation phrase.
HTTP provider failures are explicit and do not silently become local success.

workflow.output: short list of candidate posts with reasons
draft text, weighted length, and checks
write id, exact text, and random confirmation phrase

workflow.tool_hint: x_post_publish, x_post_create_api, or a Web Intent link

extending.rule: Add a connector entry. Do not change the client contract.
extending.id_rule: Unique, stable, lowercase, and never reused for a different service.
extending.operation_rule: Each operation declares read_only, side_effect, requires_confirmation, and execution_mode.
extending.write_rule: Every external side effect sets requires_confirmation to true.
extending.new_connector_rule: An unverified connector starts as optional with live_connection_verified false.
extending.verification_rule: Set live_connection_verified to true only after a live run passes with the owner present.

implemented: Offline connector runtime: describe, rank, and plan without network access.
Offline contract matrix: descriptor checks with network_calls 0.
Local mock X server with prepare, publish queue, and restore checks.
Credential-free public reads of X profile, timeline, and single post.
Local Agent Help public request board provider and MCP request tools.
not_verified: The official hosted X MCP connection and its OAuth grant.
Remote multi-tenant deployment of this gateway.
Browser automation on any real account.
Live X API reads or writes that need an OAuth user context.
A deployed public HTTP Agent Help board and multi-tenant availability.
boundaries.no_credentials: This file holds no token, secret, cookie, password, or private endpoint. Every endpoint is public or a placeholder.
